english.title: Fail to notify housing authority of change of ownership or occupation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse failed to notify the local housing authority that a

(A)_[notice to quit had been served within seven days of the service of the notice]_
(B)_[tenancy was about to expire by effluxion of time not less than four weeks before the tenancy did so expire]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 249(1)(a) of the Housing Act 1985.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
